text: Access and security - Publisher reports refusals of transfer and unavailable ambulances at Ituri control points; one Nord-Kivu control point still out of service after a September security incident (restated from earlier editions) and a persistent threat to providers along one axis; a disrupted sample transport circuit in Tshopo after the withdrawal of a dedicated vehicle (restated from SR192); persistent gaps at one Sud-Ubangi health centre (too few staff trained in infection prevention, no waste area, no triage and no provisional isolation); 5 bodies not secured or not swabbed at Nord-Kivu burials and 1 body not swabbed in Haut-Uele after family resistance; and a refusal of transfer by two suspected cases in one Haut-Uele zone, still being resolved (restated from SR192). Nord-Kivu reports 12 of 39 rings opened (30.8%), 14 of 19 health facilities decontaminated (73.7%) and 9 of 40 households decontaminated (22.5%); Ituri 13 of 19 rings, 40 of 42 households and 8 of 8 health facilities. No intervention effect is established.
